The '''Outer Moddell systems''' were a group a [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[trailing]] [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

The Outer Moddell systems included [[Ast Kikorie system/Legends|Ast Kikorie]], [[Endor system/Legends|Endor]], [[Murk system/Legends|Murk]], [[Sanyassa system/Legends|Sanyassa]], [[Trindello system/Legends|Trindello]], [[Kuna's Eye system/Legends|Kuna's Eye]], [[Kuna's Fist system/Legends|Kuna's Fist]], [[Kuna's Horn system/Legends|Kuna's Horn]], [[Kuna's Tail system/Legends|Kuna's Tail]], [[UR-1060 system/Legends|UR-1060]], [[UR-2650 system/Legends|UR-2650]], [[UR-3741 system/Legends|UR-3741]], [[UR-8827 system/Legends|UR-8827]], [[UR-9353 system/Legends|UR-9353]], and [[Zorbia system/Legends|Zorbia]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Most of the Moddell sector's traffic was found on the [[Houche Run/Legends|Annaj-Houche Run]], making up the [[Inner Moddell systems]]. Traffic dropped off considerably in the Outer Moddell beyond those systems.<ref name="Atlas" />
